newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Algeria signs $30 mln JV with Arab Gulf insurers.
newsitem.headline: Algeria signs $30 mln JV with Arab Gulf insurers.

text.p: Algeria has agreed a $30 million insurance joint-venture with two Arab Gulf insurers from Bahrain and Qatar, a deal seen as ushering in the opening of the country's insurance sector to foreign investors, industry sources said on Monday.

The joint-venture is put together by Trust Insurance company from Bahrain, the Qatar General Insurance, Algeria's state-owned Re-insurance and Insurance company, known by its French acronym CAAR, and its sister Re-insurance Central Company, CRC, they said.
The deal, setting up the joint-venture named Re-insurance and Insurance International Firm, was signed on Sunday in Algiers, they said.
The two Algerian companies hold 35 percent in the joint venture capital while the two Arab Gulf insurers hold 65 percent, the sources said.
"The newly created firm was a first step to open the Algerian-state dominated insurance sector to foreign investors," the sources said.
